# VAO 0.6.0 fixtures

`carriers/minimal.vao` comes from the released VAO 0.5.0 minimal workspace.
The VAO 0.6.0 reference migrator created a new release and the 0.6.0 packer
built this carrier. The original 69 payload bytes retain their digest.
Source workspace and derived fixture attribution remain CC BY 4.0.

`carriers/mmic-design.vao` is the unmodified synthetic design-only preservation
carrier from `Fixtures/MMIC/1.0.0/design-only/preservation-closure.vao` in
[VAO Standard v0.6.0](https://github.com/modavis-project/vao-standard/releases/tag/v0.6.0),
commit `9d477213eab90defa75bef0f44e0d292a83e68d9`. The synthetic domain data
are under CC0 1.0. Embedded code and lock files retain Apache-2.0, as declared
in the manifest. Copyright Dominik Ukolov and contributors where applicable.
